question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list his new command, staff or chief posts and his promotions or regradings in rank, in chronological order (events in the same year may be in any order).
criterion: he took up a new command, staff or chief post (including deputy chief or deputy commander) or received a promotion or regrading in rank
why_needs_multiple: Bảy mốc chức vụ và cấp bậc trong cùng một chuỗi; loại e9 (thành viên ủy ban, không phải chức vụ), e16 và e17 (kết thúc, nghỉ hưu), e18 (derived_date).

question: How many years passed between the end of his partnership in the consulting firm he joined after leaving the armed forces and his joining InterCon Consultants as a founding partner?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc nêu tên, khoảng cách năm thuần. e18 (derived_date, 1972, cùng loại consulting partnership) cách e19 7 năm, không nằm giữa e19 và e20 và không trong ngưỡng 2 năm, nên không phải B.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, summarize his Second World War service, from his enlistment in the air force until the end of the war, covering his training, postings and decorations (events with the same date in any order).
criterion: he enlisted, took wartime training courses, was posted, or received a decoration during the Second World War
why_needs_multiple: Sáu mốc thời chiến (nhập ngũ, khóa huấn luyện, bổ nhiệm, huy chương), đủ 6 mốc có ngày; e2 (tốt nghiệp RMC 1938) và e9 (1946) nằm ngoài phạm vi.
